# MP0007

Awaits the current module instance.

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Category | Usage |
| Default severity | Error |
| Availability | Public analyzer package |

## Configure severity

```ini title=".editorconfig"
dotnet_diagnostic.MP0007.severity = error
```

Use `none` to disable the rule, or `silent`, `suggestion`, `warning`, or `error` to change its severity.

## Suppress a specific occurrence

```csharp
#pragma warning disable MP0007
// Code that intentionally violates MP0007.
#pragma warning restore MP0007
```
